title: The SDSS-HET Survey of Kepler Eclipsing Binaries: Spectroscopic Dynamical Masses of the Kepler-16 Circumbinary Planet Hosts

interpretation: Deep and shallow minima alternate. The primary and secondary eclipse times separately give a 5.81080-day orbit. Both phases identify the star in sectors 40 and 56. ASAS-SN V detects the primary on four nights.
earlier_evidence: Earlier TESS-SPOC threshold crossing and the unvetted machine list of Kostov et al. (2025), Table 2. Fable 5.2 shortlisted the source.
